text: TRUMP’S PRICE TAG ON GREENLAND: NATO On Edge as Trump hints at consequences | World NewsU.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday reignited tensions with European allies by raising the prospect of acquiring Greenland during talks with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte, while again casting doubt on whether European nations would defend the United States if it were attacked. Speaking to reporters, Trump framed Greenland as vital to U.S. and international security and declined to rule out consequences for Denmark if it refused to engage in negotiations, saying they would have to “figure that out.” Rutte sought to reassure Trump of NATO’s collective defence commitment, citing allied sacrifices in Afghanistan and saying the alliance would stand with Washington, even as the exchange underscored persistent strains over burden-sharing and trust within the alliance. #donaldtrump, #nato, #greenland, #markrutte, #denmark, #uspolitics, #geopolitics, #breakingnews, #worldnews, #natomeeting, #globalsecurity, #europe, #trumpnews, #alliance, #defence #tnworld #timesnowworld #worldnews #internationalnews #timesnews #newsworld ​Subscribe now: http://bit.ly/3VHIl37 Times Now World is your definitive source for comprehensive global news and analysis.
